decision.description: approve: the document can go ahead (bot). request_changes: revise it first. done / skipped: the person did it or skipped it (actor user). acknowledged: info only (actor none).

comments.description: Comments on single sections, in document order; empty when there are none.

section.description: 1-based position of the section among the document's sections.

heading.description: The section heading as plain text.
